courses.title: Online Teaching & Tutoring Masterclass
courses.shortDescription: Live online training in online teaching & tutoring masterclass for women who want practical, home-friendly skills.
courses.description: LIVE ONLINE TRAINING – NOT A RECORDED COURSE. This one-month Zoom programme focuses on online teaching, tutoring and education delivery skills. You will attend four live classes each week, complete practical exercises and take part in question-and-answer sessions with the instructor. Supports starting tutoring sessions, online classes or teaching-related side activities from home. Intakes are planned for the 1st of every month. Exact class days and timings are shared with registered participants after enrolment. Classes are interactive; this is not a pre-recorded video course.
courses.schedule: Four live classes per week. Exact class days and timings will be shared with registered participants.
learningOutcomes: Use live class tools to keep learners engaged
requirements: Smartphone or computer with a stable internet connection
Willingness to attend scheduled live Zoom sessions
Notebook or digital document for exercises and notes
Quiet space for practice teaching sessions
